$comment: Flip2 setup wizard download catalog. Every hash below was computed from the real upstream file (sha256sum), not guessed; sizes are exact byte counts. The browser verifies each download with WebCrypto SHA-256 against these pins before anything is pushed to the phone. Nothing in this catalog is stored in the repo or attached to releases — these are pointers to upstream artifacts.

files.purpose: Flip2 single-shot Magisk installer (full tier): installs user APKs (launcher4, Null Keyboard), downloads external APKs (Forkgram, Material Files), unpacks the flip2 Magisk modules, applies baked settings and home-keys, then self-removes. Matches release v1.1.1-flip2.
files.author: MRsmallAgain (flip2 project)

files.purpose: Forkgram messenger (Telegram fork) patched for the Flip 2's small screen and keypad.
files.author: Forkgram / MRsmallAgain patch

files.purpose: whisper.cpp ggml tiny model (q5_1), used for speech-to-text by the Flip2 Null Keyboard IME. Copied to files/whisper/en/model.bin AND files/whisper/uk/model.bin (one multilingual bin serves both languages).
files.license: MIT (whisper.cpp); model weights per OpenAI whisper terms
files.author: whisper.cpp (ggerganov)

files.purpose: Vosk small US-English model — fallback STT for the IME. Unzips to a top-level model dir (am/, conf/, graph/, ivector/) which install.sh places at files/vosk/en/.
files.author: Alpha Cephei (Vosk)

files.purpose: Vosk Ukrainian nano model — fallback STT for the IME. Unzips to a top-level model dir which install.sh places at files/vosk/uk/. stt_lang defaults to uk.
files.author: Alpha Cephei (Vosk)

files.purpose: Pixel Tag Drawer v7 (0.1.6) — photo tag browser wired to the Home-key Up shortcut.
files.author: iwadjp (F-Droid)

files.purpose: Bouncy Ball v43 (1.16.0) — demo game proving multi-touch/motion works after the keypad remap.
files.author: dozingcatsoftware (F-Droid)
